answer: What survives to the copper is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The shale is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the zenith. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
